author: Yffe
content: Fixed: routed the parse_block<->parse_loop body cycle through guard_recursion. Split parse_loop into a guarded outer (self.guard_recursion(Self::parse_loop_inner)) and parse_loop_inner holding the original body, mirroring the parse_if_parts/parse_if_parts_inner pattern from #31. MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH=64 unchanged. Both probes now return SyntaxError::ExpressionTooDeep instead of SIGABRT. Converge check: grepped every parse_block caller — fn/spec-fn bodies (non-recursive, one per item), parse_if_parts_inner (guarded), parse_loop_inner (NOW guarded), parse_if_expr (reached only via guarded parse_expr ladder). All recursive families (expr/type/pattern/if-tail/loop-body) guarded; no further gap. Gauntlet: cargo test 19 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored; clippy -D warnings PASS; fmt --check PASS. Touched neither test assertions nor conformance fixtures (only removed two #[ignore]s).
